Add an explicit comparator proposition showing exactly which uniform-design bounded-overlap slice of KennedyBalakrishnanRobinsWasserman2024MinimaxCATE is recovered at kappa=0 and why the kappa>0 model is a new regime rather than a set-theoretic extension of its full density class.

Before advancing the full phase diagram, resolve the kappa=0 one-dimensional rough-nuisance product-mixture test with a legal full-support Bernoulli frame; promote the result only if it yields a same-class lower separation beyond the oracle branch.
